title: Detect a seeded arithmetic defect

criteria: Locate the false total on line 2 and explain that the sum is 5.
Classify the core factual failure as major.
Do not claim an executed tool test.

rubric.pass_if: Finds the line 2 total error with a reproducible arithmetic counterexample.
Labels the check as static and invents no additional defects.

anti_patterns: Invents a fee to justify the total.
source: Authored synthetic regression based on the council finding-quality contract.
